metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes
metrics.description: Total size of all objects in the bucket, grouped by storage class and type.

metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_count
metrics.description: Total number of objects and multipart-uploads per bucket, grouped by storage class and type.

metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/deleted_bytes
metrics.description: Count of deleted bytes per bucket, grouped by storage class.

metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/api/request_count
metrics.description: Count of API calls, grouped by the API method name and response code.

metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/network/received_bytes_count
metrics.description: Count of bytes received over the network, grouped by the API method name and response code.

metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/network/sent_bytes_count
metrics.description: Count of bytes sent over the network, grouped by the API method name and response code.

metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/authn/authentication_count
metrics.description: Count of HMAC/RSA signed requests, grouped by authentication method and response code.

metrics.name: storage.googleapis.com/authz/acl_based_object_access_count
metrics.description: Count of requests that result in an object being granted access solely due to object ACLs.
